infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pocket doesn't look at your photos. A tool built into the app mentions the photo library, so Apple asks us to say so here, but Pocket never opens it.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Pocket turns what you say into text on your phone. It doesn't send your voice anywhere.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pocket uses the microphone so you can say your question to Tim and Frank instead of typing it.
